title: CommonTrace Atomic Fact
description: A distilled, declarative atomic proposition of truth with bitemporal validity and scoped routing (EverOS + Mem0 pattern).

id.description: Unique deterministic identifier, conventionally 'fact-<12 hex chars>'.

category.description: Taxonomy category of the atomic fact.

scopes.description: Routing scopes for project, component, or team (empty list means globally applicable).

confirmations.description: Counter of confirmations or reinforcement occurrences.

valid_from.description: ISO 8601 or YYYY-MM-DD timestamp when the fact became valid.

valid_until.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the fact expired or was superseded, or null if currently valid.

source_traces.description: Trace IDs that evidenced or confirmed this fact.

status.description: Lifecycle state of the atomic fact.

superseded_by.description: Fact ID of the newer atomic fact that replaced this one, or null.

revision.description: 16-character SHA-256 cryptographic revision hash of the fact fields.
